The primitive is proved on planted CRLF/LF, CR, mixed, one-character-change, and PNG fixtures. REPO-AHEAD / LIVE-AHEAD classification is IMP-0034, which depends on this unit.

negative_controls.description: A one-character content change must still differ after normalisation, including when the changed side is CRLF.
Naive CRLF rewrite must change the PNG; the primitive must not. A probe silent in both states measures nothing.

question_or_target: Implement the comparison primitive used by every drift and integrity check: hash content after normalising line endings, and report EOL-only differences as a distinct class rather than as content drift.

reviewer.finding: bytes_for_hash: if looks_binary(data): return data; else _lf_normalise. PNG both-states control passed.
reviewer.requirement: Reviewer must confirm binary detection precedes normalisation, or normalisation corrupts binary comparisons.
